No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Commuting closure modalities model order-independent successive localizations/sublocales in Heyting semantics. The n-leaf rooted star is a canonical non-chain height-two Esakia/finite Alexandroff frame; the exact compatibility iff and exhaustive maximal-family classification apply to an infinite natural class, with full k-tuple statistics. The limiting probability 1/2, rather than decay on chains, is a structural effect of the root flag and is mathematically informative, not a tiny arbitrary finite census. Exact non-chain boundary behavior motivates the particular invariant.
